faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Attender post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Attender post is 15 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Attender position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 22 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years for the Attender position. Age relaxation details are not specified.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Attender post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th Standard. The ability to read and write the local language is preferred for this role.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Attender post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Attender post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 14000 to Rs. 19000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Attender recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted offline. You need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Attender post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Attender post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Attender post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Attender post in this recruitment by Baroda Swarojgar Vikas Sansthan.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Attender recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Attender post will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Baroda Swarojgar Vikas Sansthan (BSVS Bank of Baroda Tonk).

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Attender position?
faq.answer: The Attender position is on a contractual basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the contract.
